purpose: Teach: 人体/巧妙/弔い/思春期/罪悪/文系/パトロール/搬入

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、人体、絶対、解剖、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、勉強しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I want you to know — I'm genuinely grateful for how seriously you've studied human anatomy with our medical team.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Warm but professional. A moment of genuine acknowledgment before moving forward. Clear eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 保険詐欺の、本気で、絶対、巧妙、絶対、な、絶対、手口、絶対、貴院、絶対、注意されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Dr. Saito, I've heard your hospital has been taking great care to watch for insurance fraud schemes. That kind of vigilance is really something.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Genuine curiosity without flattery. Leaning in slightly — the third hour of conversation, asking something real.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、弔い、絶対、ご遺族、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、お見舞いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When patients pass away, our whole team makes sure to visit the families and offer our condolences. It's part of our duty to them.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. No affect, no performance — just stating what matters. Slow, deliberate pace. The weight of what she's saying sits in the silence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、思春期、絶対、の患者さん、絶対、貴院、絶対、慎重に診られているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand your hospital gives special, careful attention to adolescent patients. That takes real thoughtfulness.
lines.style: Respectful, observant tone. Not quite a question — more like he's confirming something he's learned. Pause before speaking, measuring his words.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの、本気で、絶対、罪悪、絶対、感、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、心のケア、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's right. When young patients struggle with guilt or shame, we make sure our team provides proper emotional support alongside medical care.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with quiet conviction. Not defensive — just explaining what good practice looks like. Hands steady. Voice doesn't waver.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、文系、絶対、出身の、絶対、医療事務、絶対、活躍、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've also heard that you have medical administrators from humanities backgrounds doing excellent work at your hospital.
lines.style: Admiring but not obsequious. Slow, careful phrasing — thinking as he speaks. Genuine interest in the detail, not just the compliment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。院内、本気で、絶対、パトロール、絶対、警備員、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、感謝しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Even our security staff on patrol rounds — they're part of the team, and we value what they bring to the work.
lines.style: Inclusive, no hierarchy in the way she speaks. Clear and steady. A small smile might cross her face — she genuinely means this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療機器の、本気で、絶対、搬入、絶対、貴院、絶対、完了、絶対、されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the new medical equipment your hospital ordered has finally arrived and been installed?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, wrapping up the thread. A slight lift at the end — relief and completion. Softer than before, like settling into understanding.
